bootstrap: if [ -L node_modules ]; then echo 'bootstrap: node_modules was a link; removing the link, not its target, before installing' >&2; rm node_modules; fi

agentSide: run the engine unit tests (packages/engine, node --test over test/**/*.test.ts, run directly via Node type stripping, no build step; needs Node >= 22.18 built with TypeScript support)
typecheck the engine with tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit
bundle the engine for the desktop host with esbuild (npm run build:engine --workspace @switchkeeper/desktop)
postMerge: anything that talks to a real switch over SNMP (UDP/161) or NSDP: reads, applies, save-config, discovery sweeps; no switch is reachable from the worktree host
launching or packaging the Electron desktop app (electron-builder installers for Windows, macOS, Linux)
building or running the Docker image, or observing GitHub Actions runs
